items.title: What are the main events for today?
items.summary: EUROPEAN SESSION In the European session, the only highlight is the German CPI, which is expected to show a yearly increase to 3.0% vs 2.8% prior. It goes without saying that the core measure will be more important.
items.summaryZh: 欧洲会议在欧洲会议中，唯一的亮点是德国CPI ，预计其年度增长率为3.0 ％ ，而之前为2.8 ％。不言而喻，核心措施将更加重要。
